params.linkText: pricing of an underwritten public offering

children: of 10M shares of its common stock at $9.25 per share.
The shares are being sold entirely by investment funds affiliated with private equity firms Apax Partners and Welsh, Carson, Anderson & Stowe.
The selling stockholders have granted the underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional 1.5M shares at the public offering price.
The transaction is expected to close on September 24, 2026.

InnovAge will not issue or sell any common stock in the transaction and will receive no proceeds from the sale. However, the company will bear the administrative costs associated with the offering, excluding underwriting discounts and commissions.

title: InnovAge prices 10M share secondary offering at $9.25
